title: GREED — THE HOARD
author: Beowulf the Lightbeast
content:
I guarded the prison. That was my purpose — assigned by Mundus, maintained through centuries. I collected power the way some collect weapons: methodically, without sentiment.

The half-breed came twice. The first time I drove him back. The second time he took my eye and my dignity in the same motion, then finished me before I could process that I had lost.

I do not begrudge him the victory. He was simply better prepared to want it than I was.
